description: One hooks module (orchestra.ts): injects the routing protocol at session start; denies starting long-running work from any shell (agent-exec wave run outside the orchestra-wave agent's --detach, claude -p/--print, agent-exec dispatch without --detach; ORCHESTRA_LAUNCH_GUARD); asks the main thread to re-route once a turn hand-edits enforcement.turn_edits distinct files; guards worker subagents against destructive VCS and the shared git stash (enforcement.worker_vcs), against writing the main working tree while they own a worktree (enforcement.worker_tree), against a second writer in a leased worktree (enforcement.worktree_lease), and against running the whole test suite (ORCHESTRA_TEST_GUARD); admits worker heavy commands machine-wide (throttle.heavy_slots, tests on throttle.test_slots); nudges once per session against generalist subagents that inherit the session model or name Fable (enforcement.opus_generalist) and, opt-in, direct Haiku spawns (enforcement.light_class); removes the session's clean orchestra worktrees at SessionEnd (enforcement.session_cleanup); and shows running orchestra agents and the waves the orchestra-wave watcher (or an allowed main-thread launch) starts in the status line, a detail pane (only when asked: /orchestra:progress toggles it, its own button closes it) and a band above the prompt, toasting each new wave need (userConfig hud). Every guard has escape hatches and fails open
